_doc: Validate the --stream-lanes fix for the ~1M-stream writeback wall (wal-1m-diag: one shared data device -> checkpoint syncfs of ~200k dirty files = 60-74s per shard, append staging starved, 68k @1M). Topology 3x3 via SERVER_MANIFEST=gke/durable-streams-splitlane3x3-guaranteed.yaml: dev0 = data root + stream lane 0, dev1-2 = stream lanes 1-2, dev3-5 = WAL shards 0-2; args --stream-lanes 3 --wal-shards 3. Controls (from wal-1m-diag, 5 WAL lanes + 1 data lane, same image family/QoS): 500k = 252k, 1M = 68k. Success = 1M meaningfully above 68k (expect 150k+ if writeback capacity was the binding constraint); 500k should hold >= 250k (3 WAL lanes must not regress the commit path - WAL fsync was measured far from saturation). 100k anchors against the stacked 383k. Requires STATIC_CPU=1 SPLITLANE=1 GUARANTEED=1 SERVER_MANIFEST=gke/durable-streams-splitlane3x3-guaranteed.yaml SERVER_LOCAL_SSD_BLOCK=1 SPOT_SERVER=1 BARRIER_SETUP_TIMEOUT_SECS=3600 IMG_SERVER=...:streamlanes.
